deepDetail.name: en-1440-deep
deepDetail.text: Step 7 · Flatten the groups and train One sentence. The controller flattens 32 groups into 256 records, builds train_data, and the training call updates v0 to v1. On the stage The left side retains the 32 groups, the middle CONTROLLER flattens and converts them, and the right side holds 256 training records. Train_data is summarized on the slide as tokens, response lengths and normalized rewards. Global batch size 256 matches this round’s record count. The orange training box represents one actor_model.async_train(0, data) call. The training backend can divide that call into smaller batches and may update the weights more than once; the figure leaves those internal steps out. Off-stage fields · not drawn The source also packs raw_reward, truncation flags, sample indices, loss masks and available rollout log probabilities. If the first sample’s metadata contains raw_reward, the source replaces the post-processed list with the samples’ metadata values. The slide omits these additional fields and the conditional replacement. Formula and symbols N=g×ns=B,W1=Train⁡(W0,D)N=g\times n_s=B,\qquad W_1=\operatorname{Train}(W_0,D)N=g×ns​=B,W1​=Train(W0​,D) SymbolMeaningSourcegggPrompt groupsStep 2: 32nsn_sns​Answers per groupStep 1: 8NNNTraining records after flatteningMultiplied hereBBBConfigured global batch sizeglobal-batch-size: 256DDDTrain_data built by the controllerbuffer.py:118-154W0,W1W_0,W_1W0​,W1​Model weights before and after trainingThis training callTrain⁡\operatorname{Train}TrainTraining call awaited by the main loopactor_model.async_train The numbers on the stage N=32×8=256=BN=32\times8=256=BN=32×8=256=B Train.py waits for this call with ray.get before starting the weight update. The default loss mask assigns 1 to every answer token; a supplied mask must match the actual response length. Next The new weights still belong to training. The next step waits for the update so the next SGLang round also uses v1. Sources: slime/ray/buffer.py:42-72,105-154; train.py:51-75; run-qwen3-4B.sh:51,75-78.

deepDetail.name: zh-1440-deep
deepDetail.text: 第 7 步 · 展开成训练数据并训练 一句话。 控制器把 32 组展开为 256 份记录，组成 train_data，训练调用据此把 v0 更新为 v1。 图上是什么 左侧仍按 32 组排列，中间 CONTROLLER 负责展开和转换，右侧成为 256 份训练记录。 舞台上的 train_data 只概括了 token、回答长度和归一化 rewards。 global batch size 256 与本轮记录数相等。橙色训练框表示一次 actor_model.async_train(0, data) 调用。 训练后端可以把这次调用拆成更小批次，也可能多次更新权重；这些内部步骤不在图中。 图外字段 · 未画出 源码还打包 raw_reward、截断标记、样本编号、loss mask 与已有的 rollout log probability。如果首份样本的 metadata 含有 raw_reward，源码就用各样本 metadata 中的值替换后处理得到的原始分列表。舞台没有画这些额外字段或这次条件替换。 公式与符号 N=g×ns=B,W1=Train⁡(W0,D)N=g\times n_s=B,\qquad W_1=\operatorname{Train}(W_0,D)N=g×ns​=B,W1​=Train(W0​,D) 符号是什么从哪来gggprompt 组数第 2 步，32nsn_sns​每组回答数第 1 步，8NNN展开后的训练记录数本步相乘BBB配置的全局批大小global-batch-size，256DDD控制器生成的 train_databuffer.py:118-154W0,W1W_0,W_1W0​,W1​训练前、后的模型权重本步训练调用Train⁡\operatorname{Train}Train等待完成的训练调用actor_model.async_train 代入图上的数 N=32×8=256=BN=32\times8=256=BN=32×8=256=B train.py 用 ray.get 等待这次训练结束，然后才进入权重更新。loss mask 默认在每个回答 token 上填 1，已有自定义 mask 则必须与实际回答长度一致。 接下来 新权重还在训练侧。下一步等待更新完成，让下一轮 SGLang 也使用 v1。 来源：slime/ray/buffer.py:42-72,105-154；train.py:51-75；run-qwen3-4B.sh:51,75-78。
